sequenceTutorial.descriptionText: Summon: Tap here to summon a random tower from your deck.
Game Grid: Towers are placed in random cells on this grid.
Level Info: Track the current wave and your progress here.
Kingdom Portal: Defend it at all costs!
Warning: Every enemy that reaches the portal takes a heart. Lose all hearts and the game is over!
Power-up: Use this to increase the damage of all towers of a specific type.
